title: Hypertension Emergency Guide

warningSymptoms.symptom: Severe headache that does not go away
Chest pain or tightness
Dizziness or confusion
Sudden difficulty speaking or weakness on one side of the body
Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath
Vision changes or blurred vision
Nosebleed that does not stop
Swelling in the ankles or feet

immediateActions.action: Sit or lie the person down in a comfortable position
Loosen any tight clothing around the neck and chest
If a blood pressure monitor is available, take a reading and note the numbers
If they have prescribed medication, help them take it
Call emergency services or take them to the nearest hospital immediately if symptoms are severe

whenToGoToER: Blood pressure reading above 180/120
Chest pain lasting more than 5 minutes
Sudden severe headache with confusion
Difficulty breathing
Sudden difficulty speaking, seeing, or moving one side of the body
Nosebleed that does not stop after 20 minutes of pressure
doNotDo: Do not give someone else medication
Do not ignore symptoms hoping they will pass
Do not take extra doses of blood pressure medication without medical guidance
Do not drive yourself to the hospital if you feel faint or dizzy

title: Mwongozo wa Dharura wa Shinikizo la Damu

warningSymptoms.symptom: Maumivu makali ya kichwa yasiyopungua
Maumivu au kubana kwa kifua
Kizunguzungu au kuchanganyikiwa
Kushindwa kusema ghafla au udhaifu upande mmoja wa mwili
Kushindwa kupumua au kupumua kwa shida
Mabadiliko ya kuona au kuona vitu vibaya
Kutoka damu puani isiyosimama
Kuvimba kwa vifundo vya miguu au nyayo

immediateActions.action: Mkalisheni au mlazeni mtu huyo mahali pa starehe
Legeeni nguo zozote zinazobana shingoni na kifuani
Ikiwa kuna kipimo cha shinikizo la damu, pimeni na muandike nambari
Ikiwa ana dawa aliyoandikiwa na daktari, msaidieni kuinywa
Piteni huduma za dharura au mpelekeni hospitali ya karibu mara moja dalili zikizidi

whenToGoToER: Kipimo cha shinikizo la damu kikiwa juu ya 180/120
Maumivu ya kifua yanayodumu zaidi ya dakika 5
Maumivu makali ya kichwa ghafla pamoja na kuchanganyikiwa
Kushindwa kupumua
Kushindwa kusema, kuona, au kutembeza upande mmoja wa mwili ghafla
Kutoka damu puani isiyosimama baada ya dakika 20 ya kubonyeza
doNotDo: Usimpe mtu dawa za mtu mwingine
Usipuuze dalili ukitumaini zitapita zenyewe
Usinywe dozi za ziada za dawa ya shinikizo la damu bila ushauri wa daktari
Usiendeshe gari kwenda hospitalini ukihisi kizunguzungu au udhaifu

title: Diabetes Emergency Guide

warningSymptoms.symptom: Shakiness, sweating, or sudden hunger (low blood sugar)
Excessive thirst and dry mouth (high blood sugar)
Frequent urination (high blood sugar)
Nausea or vomiting that will not stop
Fruity or acetone smell on breath (diabetic ketoacidosis)
Confusion, difficulty speaking, or disorientation
Rapid deep breathing (Kussmaul breathing)
Loss of consciousness or seizure

immediateActions.action: Check blood sugar if a glucometer is available and note the reading
If blood sugar is below 4 mmol/L (70 mg/dL), give the person a sugary drink or glucose tablets immediately
If blood sugar is above 20 mmol/L (360 mg/dL) or you see critical symptoms, call emergency services or go to the nearest hospital
Keep the person sitting upright and give small sips of water if they are conscious
Bring all current medications and the glucometer reading to the hospital

whenToGoToER: Blood sugar reading above 20 mmol/L (360 mg/dL) that does not come down
Blood sugar reading below 3 mmol/L (54 mg/dL) that does not respond to sugar intake
The person is unconscious or having a seizure
Persistent vomiting for more than 2 hours
Fruity breath smell combined with rapid breathing
Chest pain or difficulty breathing
doNotDo: Do not give insulin if you suspect low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)
Do not give food or drink to someone who is unconscious or having a seizure
Do not assume the person is drunk — diabetic emergencies can mimic alcohol intoxication
Do not delay going to the hospital while waiting for blood sugar to normalise

title: Mwongozo wa Dharura wa Kisukari

warningSymptoms.symptom: Kutetemeka, kutoka jasho, au njaa ya ghafla (sukari ya chini)
Kiu kupita kiasi na kinywa kavu (sukari ya juu)
Kukojoa mara kwa mara (sukari ya juu)
Kichefuchefu au kutapika kusikosimama
Harufu ya matunda au asetoni pumuani (ketoacidosis ya kisukari)
Kuchanganyikiwa, kushindwa kusema, au kupoteza mwelekeo
Kupumua kwa haraka na kwa kina (kupumua kwa Kussmaul)
Kupoteza fahamu au degedege

immediateActions.action: Pimeni sukari ya damu ikiwa kuna kipimo na muandike nambari
Ikiwa sukari ya damu iko chini ya 4 mmol/L (70 mg/dL), mpeni mtu kinywaji chenye sukari au vidonge vya glukosi mara moja
Ikiwa sukari ya damu iko juu ya 20 mmol/L (360 mg/dL) au dalili za hatari zinaonekana, pitieni huduma za dharura au nendeni hospitali ya karibu
Mkalisheni mtu huyo wima na mpe maji kidogo kidogo akiwa na fahamu
Pelekeni dawa zote za sasa na kipimo cha sukari hospitalini

whenToGoToER: Kipimo cha sukari ya damu kikiwa juu ya 20 mmol/L (360 mg/dL) na hakishuki
Kipimo cha sukari ya damu kikiwa chini ya 3 mmol/L (54 mg/dL) na hakiitikii sukari
Mtu amepoteza fahamu au ana degedege
Kutapika kusikosimama kwa zaidi ya masaa 2
Harufu ya matunda pumuani pamoja na kupumua kwa haraka
Maumivu ya kifua au kushindwa kupumua
doNotDo: Usimpe insulini ukishuku sukari ya damu ni ya chini (hypoglycaemia)
Usimpe chakula au kinywaji mtu aliyepoteza fahamu au anayepata degedege
Usidhani mtu amelewa — dharura za kisukari zinaweza kufanana na ulevi
Usicheleweshe kwenda hospitalini ukisubiri sukari ya damu irudi kawaida

title: General Health Emergency Guide

warningSymptoms.symptom: Sudden high fever above 39 degrees C (102 degrees F)
Persistent vomiting or diarrhoea for more than 6 hours
Severe allergic reaction with swelling of face or throat
Difficulty breathing or wheezing that gets worse
Sudden severe pain in the chest, abdomen, or head
Uncontrolled bleeding from any wound
Loss of consciousness for any duration

immediateActions.action: Stay calm and assess whether the person is conscious and breathing
If the person is unconscious but breathing, place them on their side in the recovery position
If there is bleeding, apply firm pressure with a clean cloth
Call emergency services or arrange transport to the nearest hospital
Gather all current medications and any relevant medical documents to bring to the hospital

whenToGoToER: Loss of consciousness for any duration
Difficulty breathing that does not improve
Severe allergic reaction with throat or face swelling
Uncontrolled bleeding that soaks through bandages
Severe chest pain or abdominal pain
Any injury from a fall, especially for elderly patients
doNotDo: Do not move someone who may have a spinal injury from a fall
Do not give food or water to someone who is vomiting or unconscious
Do not apply a tourniquet to stop bleeding unless you are trained to do so
Do not delay calling for help while searching for information online

title: Mwongozo wa Dharura wa Afya kwa Ujumla

warningSymptoms.symptom: Homa kali ya ghafla zaidi ya nyuzi 39 C (102 F)
Kutapika au kuharisha kusikosimama kwa zaidi ya masaa 6
Mzio mkali na kuvimba kwa uso au koo
Kushindwa kupumua au kupumua kwa shida kunakozidi
Maumivu makali ya ghafla kifuani, tumboni, au kichwani
Kutoka damu isiyodhibitika kwenye jeraha lolote
Kupoteza fahamu kwa muda wowote

immediateActions.action: Tulia na uangalie kama mtu huyo ana fahamu na anapumua
Ikiwa mtu amepoteza fahamu lakini anapumua, mlaze ubavuni katika mkao wa kupona
Ikiwa kuna kutoka damu, bonyeza kwa nguvu kwa kitambaa safi
Piga simu huduma za dharura au panga usafiri kwenda hospitali ya karibu
Kusanyeni dawa zote za sasa na nyaraka za matibabu kupeleka hospitalini

whenToGoToER: Kupoteza fahamu kwa muda wowote
Kushindwa kupumua kusikoimarika
Mzio mkali na kuvimba kwa koo au uso
Kutoka damu isiyodhibitika inayoloweka kwenye bandeji
Maumivu makali ya kifua au tumbo
Jeraha lolote kutokana na kuanguka, hasa kwa wazee
doNotDo: Usimsogeze mtu ambaye anaweza kuwa na jeraha la uti wa mgongo kutokana na kuanguka
Usimpe chakula au maji mtu anayetapika au aliyepoteza fahamu
Usifunge tourniquet kusimamisha damu isipokuwa umefunzwa kufanya hivyo
Usicheleweshe kupiga simu ya msaada ukitafuta habari mtandaoni
